description_en: Unbinds specified products from a specified project. Batch operations are supported
description_zh: 解绑指定项目下的指定产品。支持批量
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-unbind-project-products --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --project-id a12300000000 --product-keys example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUnbindProjectProducts

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
- Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
- Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The list of ProductKey values of the products to unbind from the project
parameters.help_zh: 需要解除项目中关联产品的ProductKey列表
parameters.name: product_keys
